content: Can you cleanse your inner vision until you see nothing but the light?
author: Lao Tzu
sourceWork: Tao Te Ching, Book of Virtue
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

In Lao Tzu's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: How can you create a moment of stillness today to reconnect with your deeper sense of purpose?
